items.q: How do I count PS5 trophies automatically in OBS?
items.a: Connect your PSN account in StatsCounter Desktop, pick the game and add the widget to OBS. Every bronze, silver, gold or platinum trophy you earn updates the counter on its own, with no chat commands and no capture card needed.

items.q: Does it work with Steam achievements?
items.a: Yes. Connect your Steam account to track achievements for any game in your library, including Steam Family games installed on your PC. You can also show a fully editable animated banner on stream every time you unlock an achievement.

items.q: Does the counter work with Steam achievement sets?
items.a: Yes. Steam released achievement sets to everyone on November 11, 2026, and the app already follows the same rule: the counter's total matches what Steam shows. A DLC's achievements only count after you earn your first one from it, and a retired achievement (one nobody can earn anymore) leaves the total if you don't have it, so your 100% is never blocked by content you don't own. On the Steam Banner, each achievement shows which set it belongs to, and you get an alert when you complete one. Not every game has sets yet, since it's up to each developer; for the rest, nothing changes.

items.q: Does it work with PS4 and retro games?
items.a: Yes. PSN sync tracks the trophies on your account, from both PS5 and PS4. For retro games and emulators, connect your RetroAchievements account.

items.q: Can I show on stream how many trophies are left to the platinum?
items.a: Yes. The game trophies card shows one game's trophies split by type (bronze, silver, gold and platinum), with how many are left or how many you have earned, the completion percentage and the latest trophy. There is also the PSN profile card, with your level and trophy totals. Both update on their own with every trophy while the app and OBS are open.

items.q: How do I count deaths on stream without letting go of the controller?
items.a: Set up global hotkeys in StatsCounter Desktop: they work even with your game in fullscreen and the app minimized, so every death hits your OBS counter with a single shortcut, without switching windows. Viewers can check the total anytime with !deaths.

items.q: Do I need to keep a browser open?
items.a: No. The app runs on Windows and Linux and keeps syncing and responding to global hotkeys even while minimized.

items.q: Does it work with Twitch and Kick chat?
items.a: Yes. The StatsCounter bot posts a chat message every time your death or trophy counter goes up, and you can write your own custom messages. Viewers can also type commands like !deaths or !trophies and the bot instantly replies with the stream's current count, and the commands are customizable too.

items.q: How much does the desktop app cost?
items.a: Access is unlocked for supporters who contribute US$ 20 or more on Buy Me a Coffee (or R$ 20 in Brazil). It's lifetime: pay once and get every future update.

current_features.timer_title: Timer and latest trophy on the widget
current_features.timer_description: Track how long it took you to move from one trophy to the next, and show the date of your latest trophy and the name of the trophy you just unlocked, with its rarity, right on the widget. The death counter has a timer too, showing when your last death happened. And when you hit 100%, the counter plays a special completion animation.
current_features.timer_screenshot_alt: Desktop app screenshot showing the timer and latest trophy on the widget
current_features.customization_description: You can now customize the counter completely, including font, shadow, color, font size, counter position, icon size, icon placement, and much more. Besides the app's fonts, you can use the ones installed on your PC, with a live preview on the widget before you choose. You can also upload your own images or GIFs as the trophy and death icons, and choose the trophy counter text style: inline (default), fraction, progress bar, or percentage.
current_features.customization_screenshot_alt: Desktop app screenshot showing the full counter customization options
current_features.customization_screenshot_alt_2: Desktop app screenshot showing the trophy counter text in fraction format
current_features.steam_sets_description: Steam released achievement sets to everyone on November 11, and the app already supports them: the total matches Steam's, and DLC only counts after your first achievement from it. Not every game has sets yet; for the rest, nothing changes.
current_features.steam_banner_alt: Desktop app GIF showing the Steam achievement banner appearing in OBS
current_features.steam_banner_description: Every time you unlock an achievement, an animated banner slides into your stream showing what you just earned. It is synced with your Steam account, works with any game in your library and is fully editable: background, colors, fonts, sound, entry animation and time on screen. In games with achievement sets (base game, DLC), the banner shows which set it belongs to and lets you know when you complete one.
current_features.steam_banner_alt_2: Desktop app screenshot showing the Steam achievement banner editing options
current_features.psn_profile_alt: Desktop app GIF showing the PSN profile card in OBS
current_features.psn_profile_description: Show your PlayStation profile on stream: level, trophy totals by type, game count and the game you are playing right now. The card is synced with your PSN account and updates on its own with every trophy you earn.
current_features.psn_game_card_alt: Game trophies card in OBS, with the game cover and trophies split by type
current_features.psn_game_card_description: Pick a game and show its trophies on stream split by type: bronze, silver, gold and platinum. See how many are left to the platinum or how many of each type you have earned, with the completion percentage and the latest trophy with its rarity. The card is synced with your PSN account and updates on its own with every trophy.
current_features.twitch_description: Connect your Twitch or Kick account to the StatsCounter bot, and it posts a chat message every time your death or trophy counter goes up. Choose which widgets trigger it and write your own custom messages. Same features on both platforms.

items.text: Steam achievements counted just like Steam does: DLC only counts after your first achievement from it, and retired achievements no longer block 100%.
Steam Banner shows which set an achievement belongs to and lets you know when you complete one.
Steam Family games in the counter and Steam Banner game list.
Steam Banner shows up right away again in games where it was delayed.
Fonts installed on your PC in the death and trophy widgets and in the Steam Banner, with search and preview.
Game trophy card (PSN): how many trophies of each type are left, live in OBS.
Tabbed dashboard, with a tab for just the cards you use.
Trophy names in PS3, PS4 and PS Vita games, with rarity.
All 11 game themes redesigned, with each game's shape, frame and font.
Dashboard cards now match the OBS widget.
PSN profile card: avatar, level and trophies on stream, animated on every trophy.
Full Steam Banner editor: font, colors, background, border, icon and entrance.

roadmap.text: Gameplay Timer: play time on stream, with pause all and per-DLC timers.
Hunter mode: the trophy you are hunting on screen, with a celebration when it pops.
New trophy chat commands on Twitch: !progresso, !ultimo and !sessao.
Faster achievement detection in the counter, starting with Steam.
